supported_claims: Viewer session responses omit tenant and clinician identifiers and do not expose configured ASR profiles or local clinical-model availability.
Viewer encounter lists and encounter-scoped reads are restricted to records explicitly marked synthetic; non-synthetic legacy records fail closed as not found.
Deletion-request status responses apply the same synthetic-only viewer boundary and omit the joined encounter body.
Every registered route remains covered by explicit authorization policy; identity routes reject missing authentication and viewer writes.
The public investor preview remains static synthetic content with no API calls.
limitations: No real-patient data or production Google Workspace deployment was available for testing.

Viewer list filtering is applied after the actor-scoped database query because the persisted encounter body is cross-backend JSON text; very large histories may need a normalized synthetic flag/index.
The study dashboard and public demo-case endpoints expose only development evaluation metadata and public synthetic references, but independent privacy review has not been performed.
